bio: After a stroll through the city, how about dinner at a chic restaurant with a trendy modern decor? There are plenty of options to choose from here at Weingut, including house specialities, steaks, plus a selection of dishes that changes every week (see the Wochenkarte). Alternatively, you could simply opt for tapas or a glass of wine – you can also buy bottles to take home. The service is very friendly and attentive. Decorative wine racks and high tables contribute to the pleasant wine bar atmosphere of the place. There are two reservation times: 17:30 - 20:00 and from 20:15....
